crop.pilot_relevance: Key climate-resilient staple crop of Central Dry Zone with high dietary and economic importance

sowing_window.late_contingency: August 1 to August 20 (short duration varieties like KMR-316 or ML-365)

soil_requirements.tolerance: Remarkable drought tolerance once established; tolerates marginal soils better than maize or groundnut

varieties.name: ML-365
varieties.characteristics: Blast tolerant, medium tall, high grain and straw yield, drought resilient

varieties.name: GPU-28
varieties.characteristics: Widely adopted standard variety, moderate blast resistance

varieties.name: KMR-316
varieties.characteristics: Short duration, suited for delayed monsoon and late kharif sowings in dry zones

nutrient_recommendation.source: UAS Bangalore Package of Practices (Zone IV)
nutrient_recommendation.organic_manure: 7.5 to 10 tonnes/ha FYM or compost incorporated 2-3 weeks prior to sowing

major_pests_and_diseases.symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions with grey centers on leaves; black lesions on neck causing head breakage
major_pests_and_diseases.cultural_control: Grow resistant varieties (ML-365); seed treatment with bio-agents (Trichoderma)
major_pests_and_diseases.approved_chemical: Tricyclazole 75% WP or carbendazim 50% WP as per CIB&RC Major Uses
